answer: Behavioral Pulse Clustering. Each agent signs every action so the platform can cipher its timing into an anonymized pulse trace. After the fact, a clustering pass groups traces with near-identical cadence and response latencies; a cluster above a size threshold triggers weight reduction. Because every identity needs realistic timing jitter, attacker cost is one ember of sustained compute per identity for weeks of continuous, non-correlated activity, and single missed scheduling reset collapses the whole cluster.
